chapter: Early heroes and Kid Ory band
title: Head men of early jazz and Buddy Bolden
summary: He names the early head men and tells how as a boy he fetched beer for Buddy Bolden; briefly mentions Buddy Christian's death.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: The head men. The way they used to call them. Peter Hunter. John Rubishow. King Oliver. Louis Armstrong. Fink Martin. You didn't know Buddy Bowling, did you? Yeah, I was a little kid then. Yeah. He stayed at the corner for a while. And one day I was passing and he called me in. And he told me, he said, you drunk brother, isn't he? I said, yes sir. And he said, go down there and get me fifteen cents a beer. And the one time he got him fifteen cents a beer. You know, we used to go there and shoot down, look under the doors and knock, then somebody come and get the bucket. But I carried it there. And he told me to come in. And when I went in, I'm about to run home and told my brother, I said, you little brother's client down there with Kid Bowling. He's in the room. He said, go down there and get me a little time. And knock on the door. And knock on the door. And the brother Bowling comes in the door. He said, hello John. He said, what's your name? He said, buddy, how are you? I come for my little brother. He said, you got to go somewhere else. He said, right there he is. And so he said, they talked a little while. He said, all right, buddy, I see you, Simone. My brother said, all right. He said, you know who that is? I said, no, who is it, John? He said, that's Buddy Bowling. I said, what? That's Buddy Bowling. He said, there's nothing there. That baby died not so long ago. He was another one, Big. Everything was him. Then after him, there was a little fella called Edward Klim. I used to always take Edward Klim for Buddy Bowling. You know. Really? Let me see. Tell that. Buddy Scott, you ever met him? Get up there. So you ever met Buddy Scott?
Oh, you don't know him. I heard him. Buddy Christian, you ever met him?
He passed about nine months ago. Yeah, what is it?
He passed. So he died about nine months ago.
Oh, yeah. I didn't know him. Well, I went to New York about three months ago. Yeah.
Oh, yeah. He never did come back yet. But me and him both, we used to go down to live as a young girl. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
